description: This source file implements the SetCaps class for WebAudio, responsible for setting and updating GStreamer caps for audio streams, including building caps based on audio MIME type and configuration, and managing caps lifecycle within a GStreamer pipeline.

classes.name: WebAudioCapsBuilder
classes.description: Abstract base class for building WebAudio GStreamer caps, providing an interface for building caps with derived classes implementing specific configurations.

classes.name: WebAudioPcmCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class from WebAudioCapsBuilder that constructs caps for PCM audio configurations, including format specification based on PCM settings.

classes.name: SetCaps
classes.description: Main class responsible for setting GStreamer caps on a WebAudio pipeline, including creating caps based on MIME type, updating pipeline caps, and calculating bytes per sample.

methods.name: SetCaps
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SetCaps object with context, wrappers, MIME type, and configuration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the main logic of creating and setting caps on the GStreamer appsrc element, and updates bytes per sample.

methods.name: createCapsFromMimeType
methods.description: Creates GstCaps object based on the MIME type, using appropriate caps builder.

methods.name: setBytesPerSample
methods.description: Calculates and sets the bytes per sample in the context based on PCM configuration.
